shared_tail.surface: أبي عثمان مولى المغيرة بن شعبة

notes: Hafs's branch names no level after him («حدثنا ح»); the shared tail is written once after the merge («ثم اتفقا»), so it is taken as written after each branch.
The long dashed remark (Ibn Kathir's «حدثني منصور» and «إذا قرأته على») is an editor's gloss on wording and is left out.
The Prophet is the end; Abu Hurayra is the last written link.
